selection.rationale: Purposive, family-balanced screen: five VMTs each from mypyvy, Cubicle, Lambda/MCMT, IvyBench. Retains 12 earlier screening cases (known abstract losses) and adds eight for breadth. Not a random corpus estimate. Excludes known contradictory distrib_channels initializer. Source families overlap semantically; counts are files, not independent algorithms.

method.meaning: Count recorded completed depths within the wall budget; a started depth earns no credit. No unbounded proof claim.
